types.name: Hidden Icons
types.desc: Neon markers tucked across every district.
types.reward: A slice of your 100% and a cash bonus per ten found.

items.name: Ocean Beach lifeguard tower
items.where: On the roof of the pink tower at the north end of the sand. Climb the ladder at the back.

items.name: VC Port crane
items.where: At the top of the tallest yellow crane. Take the stairs inside the frame, not the ladder.

items.name: End of the road
items.where: Behind the sign where the highway stops, facing the water.

items.name: Ranger lookout
items.where: Inside the fire lookout cabin at the summit trailhead.

types.name: Vice Tapes
types.desc: Lost cassettes that add tracks to the radio.
types.reward: Each tape unlocks a track. A full set unlocks a station.

items.name: Little Cuba bakery
items.where: On the counter next to the register.

items.name: Boardwalk arcade
items.where: Under the broken claw machine at the back.

types.name: Street Art
types.desc: Murals worth photographing around the state.
types.reward: Photograph all of them for an outfit.

items.name: Underpass mural
items.where: On the north pillar under the causeway.

items.name: Motel wall
items.where: The side wall of the closed motel, facing the parking lot.

items.name: Refinery gate
items.where: On the water tank left of the main gate.

types.name: Gator Nests
types.desc: Hidden out in the Grassrivers swampland.

items.name: Airboat dock
items.where: In the reeds twenty metres east of the dock. Approach by boat.

items.name: Sunken pickup
items.where: On the mud bank beside the half-sunk truck.

types.name: Time Capsules
types.desc: Buried throwbacks out in the backcountry.
types.reward: Each one holds a vintage item.

items.name: Old campsite
items.where: Under the stone ring of the abandoned fire pit.

items.name: Hunter's blind
items.where: At the foot of the wooden blind, on the dry side.
